name: @katkee/backend
description: KATKEE backend API — Story-first social network (Phase 1-11: full feature set through moderation + production hardening — see README.md).

katkeeNotes.networkSandboxLimitation: This session's environment blocks registry.npmjs.org and pypi.org, so no third-party package can be installed here (verified: both return 'Host not in allowlist'). All runtime code in src/ therefore uses only Node.js built-ins (node:http, node:crypto, node:child_process) so it can run and be tested today. Once network access is available, replace src/db/psql.ts with the `pg` driver and src/modules/auth/tokens.ts + password.ts with `jsonwebtoken` / a maintained scrypt-based hasher if desired — both already speak the standard wire formats (real JWT, real scrypt) so the swap is a drop-in behind the same function signatures.
